title: Formal Modeling in Software Engineering with LLMs: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.18577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formal verification provides strong correctness guarantees for software systems but remains hindered by the substantial expertise and manual effort required to construct and maintain formal models. The recent rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has prompted growing interest in whether their natural language understanding and generation capabilities can be leveraged to automate labor-intensive modeling activities. This paper presents a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) examining how LLMs have been applied to automate model checking and the generation of formal and semi-formal models within software engineering. The review follows established SLR methodologies and a PICOC-driven search strategy across four major digital libraries. From an initial search of 1,193 articles, 34 peer-reviewed conference, journal, and workshop articles published between 2022 and April 2026 were selected and analyzed using a structured data extraction form. translated_title: 软件工程中基于大语言模型的形式化建模：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 形式化验证能够为软件系统提供强大的正确性保证，但构建和维护形式化模型所需的大量专业知识与人工工作仍然是其发展的障碍。近期大语言模型（LLMs）的兴起引发了人们日益浓厚的兴趣：能否利用其自然语言理解与生成能力来自动化劳动密集型的建模活动。本文开展了一项系统性文献综述（SLR），考察大语言模型如何被应用于自动化模型检测以及软件工程中形式化和半形式化模型的生成。该综述遵循既定的SLR方法学，并采用基于PICOC的检索策略在四大主要数字图书馆中进行检索。从最初检索到的1,193篇文章中，最终筛选出34篇发表于2022年至2026年4月之间的同行评审会议、期刊和研讨会文章，并使用结构化数据提取表对其进行了分析。
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，梳理了大语言模型在软件工程中自动化模型检测与形式化/半形式化模型生成方面的研究进展，从1,193篇候选文献中筛选并分析了34篇发表于2022至2026年间的同行评审论文。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic literature review examining how LLMs have been applied to automate model checking and the generation of formal and semi-formal models in software engineering, analyzing 34 peer-reviewed articles published between 2022 and April 2026 out of 1,193 initially retrieved.
